faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PEDRO

q1.question: How does PEDRO work?
q1.answer: PEDRO automatically finds the best deals in your area. Just open the app and Pedro will show you current offers at nearby shops and venues.

q2.question: Is the app free?
q2.answer: Yes! PEDRO is completely free for users. We earn through partnerships with local businesses.

q3.question: How do I add a coupon to my wallet?
q3.answer: Just tap "Use" on the deal you want. The coupon will automatically appear in your wallet, ready to scan at checkout.

q4.question: Can I use it offline?
q4.answer: Saved coupons can be used offline. Browsing new deals requires an internet connection.

q5.question: How can I add my business?
q5.answer: Click "Add your business" in the business section or contact us. Adding deals is simple and takes about 2 minutes.

q6.question: Is PEDRO available outside Tricity?
q6.answer: We're currently focused on Gdańsk, Gdynia, and Sopot. But we'll be expanding to other cities in Poland soon!
